invariants.rule: No tool selection, proximity, snap, form field, or completion button substitutes for the required physical sequence.
Visible fields exist on readable object media; inspection and comparison do not auto-generate the answer.
Case03 exterior repair never requires opening the customer's private contents; Case04 opening remains optional and deliberate.
Refolding/resealing/cancelling never removes recorded opening or private exposure; visible residual damage remains inspectable.
Mail and loose contents have one coherent owner; handoff transaction commits exactly once.
Reading, inspecting and dragging do not advance the game clock.
Professional reliability, individual NPC trust, objective facts, and visible tamper traces are separate domains.
No fixed opening tickets; no instant failure ending for one error; documented lawful non-delivery is not automatic misconduct.
Recipient attention and visible trace state produce repeatable detection; no hidden casino RNG.
Exit/resume restores stable partial work without auto-repair, auto-reseal, auto-handoff or erased trace.
Keyboard uses the same target/contact/geometry rules and same required stages without needing held-mouse precision or timed reading.
All scenario statuses remain NOT_EXECUTED until an actual input adapter produces evidence; static reference screenshot is not movement or sound proof.

actions.input_required: 命中物件并按住指针；或焦点抓取锁定后方向输入
actions.commit_rule: 仅建立抓点/移动控制，不发放线索或完成案件

actions.input_required: 保持抓取的连续移动/键盘分步位移
actions.commit_rule: 保持起始抓取偏移；不在松手前投递

actions.input_required: 松开或结束键盘抓取
actions.commit_rule: 落到桌面仅改变位置；交付必须另过交付守卫

actions.input_required: 翻面手势/独立映射按键
actions.commit_rule: 显示真实另一面；不自动整理线索或翻完立即开封

actions.input_required: 滚轮/缩放键后拖动/方向平移
actions.commit_rule: 改变观察视图，不移动邮件所有权或推理状态

actions.input_required: 将第二文档放到并置区域
actions.commit_rule: 两件可独立移动/翻面/缩放，不输出 MATCH/答案

actions.input_required: 把受损件实际拖入修复垫
actions.commit_rule: 启用受损外标签相关操作；不破坏封口

actions.input_required: 抓取抽象工具或键盘选择焦点工具
actions.commit_rule: 只切换手持工具，不修改材质或选择伦理结论

actions.input_required: 工具有效接触已脱落标签
actions.commit_rule: 标签成为可移动物，正文仍遮蔽

actions.input_required: 移动并旋转标签，断边几何关系成立
actions.commit_rule: 可轻微吸附但仍需保护页与压平；不自动公布地址答案

actions.input_required: 保护页实际覆盖并经接触压平
actions.commit_rule: 外标签趋平，暴露该物件确实存在的字段

actions.input_required: 对齐已有外折痕，再翻回/缩放复查
actions.commit_rule: 外部修复结束；并不作出路线判断或投递

actions.input_required: 选中抽象开启工具后主动沿可见封线持续接触
actions.commit_rule: 首次有效破坏接触记越界事实，封舌逐步松动；仍不抽出内页

actions.input_required: 抓住露出的内页边缘并连续拉出
actions.commit_rule: 内页位置由输入推进，越过包络口后成为独立物

actions.input_required: 分别抓住折页并打开
actions.commit_rule: 只让已暴露区域可读；不预先向UI/无障碍标签输出遮住的文字

actions.input_required: 沿原有折线移动折页
actions.commit_rule: 对齐的折页才进入可装回外形；不能一键复原所有折页

actions.input_required: 折好内页后拖向信封口
actions.commit_rule: 满足包络与方向守卫后逐步进入；不能因靠近自动传送

actions.input_required: 抓住封舌并合回
actions.commit_rule: 封舌闭合但尚未完成最终封口动作

actions.input_required: 对已闭合封舌实施抽象封口接触动作
actions.commit_rule: 产生可见最终封口状态；原有阅读/开启历史和可见损伤不被清零

actions.input_required: 持物点击收件目标后实际走近；或手动移动接近
actions.commit_rule: 到达只进入可交接范围，绝不转移所有权

actions.input_required: 在可达范围内将实际信封递向合法接收目标并释放
actions.commit_rule: 重新验证身份/服务/封装/所有权/交易ID后，原子提交一次移交

actions.input_required: Esc/取消映射键/把物件收回
actions.commit_rule: 停止当前抓取或走近，保留此前已提交材质及已读事实

actions.input_required: 真实退出/存档/重开入口
actions.commit_rule: 恢复稳定物态和观察位置，释放所有输入捕获；不自动完成任何工序

actions.input_required: 玩家在可回查书页主动记录观察或暂定推断
actions.commit_rule: 未知仍未知；暂定不等于已核实
